newsitem.title: USA: Possis Medical Q4 July 31 loss widens.
newsitem.headline: Possis Medical Q4 July 31 loss widens.

text.p: Possis Medical Inc, which makes medical devices for the cardiovascular and vascular markets, said Tuesday its net loss for the fourth quarter ended July 31 widened to $0.24 a share from $0.19 a year ago.
Based on preliminary unaudited fourth quarter results, Possis said its total revenues for the quarter rose to $1,208,000 compared with $830,000. No further results for the fourth quarter were given.
For the fiscal year, the net loss was $0.70 a share ago, compared with a loss of $0.70 a year ago. Total revenues for the year were $4,834,000, up from $1,606,000 a year ago.

"We closed out the year with strong U.S. AngioJet System sales of $1,086,000, which included our first four U.S. drive unit sales," Robert Dutcher, president, said in a statement. "This is an increase of 67 percent from the last quarter."
Fourth quarter sales of the AngioJet System in Europe were down significantly from the prior quarter, he added.

"In part this was the result of having terminated our German distributor and also becuse of expected sluggish sales occurring during the European vacation/holiday months of July and August," Dutcher said.
He said Possis is pleased with the progress made to date in introducing the AngioJet System to the U.S. marketplace.

"Our fiscal 1998 plans are to significantly grow U.S. AngioJet System revenues by adding direct sales personnel and broadening product label claims through clinical studies and additonal FDA (U.S. Food and Drug Administration) submissions," he added.
